title: When Does 3^n End in 01? (short)
style: warm and upbeat, speaking at a lively pace, no laughing

lines: Three, nine, twenty-seven, eighty-one. Powers of three grow fast!
Can one end in zero one?
What is the smallest n, so three to the n ends in zero one?
The last digit loops: three, nine, seven, one. So only every fourth power ends in one.
Three to the fourth is eighty-one. Four powers later, the tens digit drops by two.
Sixty-one, forty-one, twenty-one, and then zero one!
Five jumps of four powers. So n is twenty!
Check: three to the twentieth ends in zero one.
Why does it drop? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
